p1: Every night at 3 a.m., the elevator on my floor opens by itself. And it's always full.
Monday, it dinged open while I was taking the rubbish out. Everyone inside faced the back wall.
One old lady wore a pink dressing gown. Then a man in a black suit turned around and smiled.
There was one gap, right in the middle. I said, no thanks... and took the stairs.
Next morning, Frank the concierge played me the elevator camera. The elevator was empty. Just me, talking to nobody.
Then Frank went pale. Mrs Hale from 14B wore that pink dressing gown. She died on Sunday.
Every night since, the elevator's been fuller. Last night, there was no gap left.
The man in the suit just smiled at me.
It's almost 3 a.m. now... and I can hear it coming up.
